newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst Q1 pretax up adjusted 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst Q1 pretax up adjusted 9 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Full name of the German chemicals group is Hoechst AG.

*The company said in a mandatory statement that pre-tax profit was up nine percent on an adjusted basis. It also said that operating profit fell 22 percent compared with the first quarter of 1996 but rose by 20 percent on an adjusted basis. The earnings adjustments are for the following factors:
1. The first quarter of 1997 contains 195 million marks in restructuring costs which was up 110 million marks from the year-earlier restructuring costs.

2. The first quarter of 1996 contained 300 million marks income from the sale of Hoechst's printing plate business and a 85 million-mark profit contribution from SGL Carbon AG in which Hoechst now no longer has a majority stake.
